name: xyz.usdctofiat/cash-out
title: USDCtoFiat
description: Compare ways to cash out USDC, open a prefilled sell form, and check on a cash-out. Read-only.

tools.name: usdctofiat_routes
tools.description: USDC seller rates and live listed depth on usdctofiat.xyz for one currency, optionally one payout app. Past fills, not a quote. Returns a prefilled sell link per route; selling happens on the site from the user's own wallet.

platform.description: Payout app id, e.g. revolut, wise, venmo

tools.name: usdctofiat_best_route
tools.description: Use when someone wants to cash out, off-ramp or sell USDC for fiat. Returns the main ways to turn an amount of USDC into one fiat currency, ranked by cash received: peer-to-peer on usdctofiat.xyz (paid to Revolut, Monzo, Venmo, Cash App, Zelle, PayPal and others), exchanges, off-ramps, direct deposit into payment apps, and cards. Each route states its figure, how the figure was obtained, typical time and whether a new account is needed. Estimates, not quotes.

amount.description: USDC to cash out, 10 to 100000. Default 1000

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to be paid in, e.g. GBP

from.description: Network the USDC is on: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

tools.name: usdctofiat_sell_link
tools.description: A link that opens the usdctofiat.xyz sell form prefilled with an amount of USDC, a currency, a payment app and a speed (fast: market rate; best: managed rate). Without a payment app, the peer-to-peer route that pays most in the comparison is used; without a speed, the one behind that app's figure in the comparison. The link only fills the form: it does not connect a wallet, sign anything or move money. The user reviews, connects their own wallet and confirms on the site.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to be paid in, e.g. EUR

platform.description: Payment app to be paid to, e.g. revolut, monzo, venmo, cashapp, zelle, paypal

speed.description: fast (market rate) or best (managed rate). Omit to use the speed behind the comparison's figure

tools.name: usdctofiat_order_status
tools.description: Use to check on a cash-out the user already started on usdctofiat.xyz, for example "has my order filled?" or "where is my money?". Give the Base wallet address they sold from (a public 0x address; never ask for a seed phrase or private key) and get that seller's deposits as the site's Deposits page shows them: USDC listed, filled and remaining, payout app, currency and rate, buyers paying now, last fill time and a link to manage each one. It reads public Base chain data through the protocol indexer and needs no sign-in. Read-only: it cannot release, cancel, withdraw, pause or change an order. For any action, give the user the manage link, where they connect their own wallet.

address.description: Base wallet address the user sold from: 0x followed by 40 hex characters

deposit_id.description: One deposit's id from the site or a previous result, to look at just that one
